capabilities.intent: Create, list, and update OSC case records.
capabilities.verify: Require an API success response and the persisted case state.
capabilities.human_handling: Stop on validation or identity conflicts and request operator review.

capabilities.intent: Close a case through the guarded OSC case workflow.
capabilities.verify: Require the close response and resulting case status.
capabilities.human_handling: Do not retry an uncertain close; inspect the case history with an operator.

capabilities.intent: Create, list, and update client records through OSC.
capabilities.verify: Require an API success response and the persisted client record.
capabilities.human_handling: Escalate duplicate or ambiguous client identity matches for review.

capabilities.intent: Create, list, and update calendar events in OSC.
capabilities.verify: Require the returned event state and conflict checks before completion.
capabilities.human_handling: Hold ambiguous dates or conflicting events for operator confirmation.

capabilities.intent: Create, list, and update case todo records.
capabilities.verify: Require an API success response and the resulting todo status.
capabilities.human_handling: Leave uncertain deadlines open for operator triage.

capabilities.intent: Finalize prepared document artifacts through the OSC workflow.
capabilities.verify: Require successful artifact generation and its registered output state.
capabilities.human_handling: Preserve source artifacts and route failed finalization for review.

capabilities.intent: Upload a case file through the guarded OSC file endpoint.
capabilities.verify: Require the upload response and stored file metadata.
capabilities.human_handling: Do not replace an uncertain upload; retain the source file for operator review.

capabilities.intent: Check and restore configured NAS share availability.
capabilities.verify: Require each configured share to report available after the guard run.
capabilities.human_handling: Stop on unavailable shares and request storage or network remediation.

capabilities.intent: Upload planned NAS files to managed Drive folders.
capabilities.verify: Require each upload result to be successful and free of partial failures.
capabilities.human_handling: Keep failed transfers for operator reconciliation before another upload.

capabilities.intent: Download planned Drive files to managed NAS folders.
capabilities.verify: Require each download result to be successful and preserve the target file checks.
capabilities.human_handling: Route partial transfers or path conflicts for operator reconciliation.

capabilities.intent: Prepare a legal-aid portal draft without treating a failed result as complete.
capabilities.verify: Require the orchestrator JSON success flag and the portal draft result.
capabilities.human_handling: Stop on failure and route the draft for operator review before retrying.

capabilities.intent: Submit a legal-aid portal action after the required confirmation flow.
capabilities.verify: Require JSON success and a confirmed portal submission response.
capabilities.human_handling: Do not repeat an uncertain submission; obtain operator confirmation and inspect the portal record.

capabilities.intent: Read case activity counts without changing the portal.
capabilities.verify: Require a parsed JSON identity and counts payload.
capabilities.human_handling: Ask an operator to resolve an ambiguous case identity.

capabilities.intent: Inspect downloadable file-review work without downloading or changing state.
capabilities.verify: Require a successful portal probe; diagnostics cannot replace the portal result.
capabilities.human_handling: Stop for missing dependencies or credentials and request operator remediation.

capabilities.intent: Prepare or submit a file-review application through the portal workflow.
capabilities.verify: Require the returned success state and portal workflow evidence before reporting completion.
capabilities.human_handling: Keep uncertain applications in the confirmation workflow for operator review.

capabilities.intent: Download approved file-review materials into the managed workspace.
capabilities.verify: Require the download result to report success and preserve its status record.
capabilities.human_handling: Stop bulk work when the case scope is uncertain and ask an operator to select the case.

capabilities.intent: Download transcripts for one identified case.
capabilities.verify: Require the explicit success result and downloaded-file summary.
capabilities.human_handling: Route portal authentication or captcha failures to the manual review queue.

capabilities.intent: Synchronize transcripts with locking, deduplication, and optional rename processing.
capabilities.verify: Require a successful sync result and batch summary after the sync lock is acquired.
capabilities.human_handling: Fail closed when the sync lock is unavailable; route captcha and portal failures for review.

capabilities.intent: Index transcript documents for later retrieval.
capabilities.verify: Require the index result to report processed and failed counts.
capabilities.human_handling: Keep unreadable transcript files for operator repair instead of marking them indexed.

capabilities.intent: Convert a supplied audio recording into text with the local speech engine.
capabilities.verify: Require an explicit success result and nonempty transcript text.
capabilities.human_handling: Request a usable recording or operator transcription when speech recognition fails.

capabilities.intent: Translate supplied text or document content through the translation workflow.
capabilities.verify: Require a successful translation result and requested output artifact when exporting.
capabilities.human_handling: Route terminology or quality conflicts to an operator before delivery.

capabilities.intent: Combine available OCR provider results into a confidence-aware transcription.
capabilities.verify: Require a consensus result with confidence and provider evidence.
capabilities.human_handling: Escalate low-confidence legal text for manual verification.

capabilities.intent: Search the legal statute knowledge source for a requested provision.
capabilities.verify: Require a structured search result with source references.
capabilities.human_handling: Ask an operator to verify an ambiguous or missing provision.

capabilities.intent: Collect and store judicial decisions through the judgment workflow.
capabilities.verify: Require a successful collection result and stored judgment summary status.
capabilities.human_handling: Keep retrieval or summary failures visible for legal research review.

capabilities.intent: Fetch configured research sources into a managed research namespace.
capabilities.verify: Require a successful fetch result with source and ingestion counts.
capabilities.human_handling: Review unavailable sources or unexpected content before publishing a brief.

capabilities.intent: Generate a case drafting artifact through the OSC drafting endpoint.
capabilities.verify: Require the generated draft response and its output artifact metadata.
capabilities.human_handling: Treat drafts as reviewable work product and require operator approval before use.

capabilities.intent: Manage accounting transactions through the protected OSC endpoint.
capabilities.verify: Require an API success response and recalculated transaction state.
capabilities.human_handling: Escalate accounting discrepancies for operator reconciliation.

capabilities.intent: Create, list, and update quotations through OSC.
capabilities.verify: Require an API success response and the persisted quotation state.
capabilities.human_handling: Hold uncertain pricing or recipient details for operator confirmation.

capabilities.intent: Capture an approved user rule through the memory confirmation flow.
capabilities.verify: Require the memory flow result to confirm the approved capture state.
capabilities.human_handling: Do not store ambiguous instructions; request explicit user confirmation.

capabilities.intent: Write an approved note into the configured Obsidian vault.
capabilities.verify: Require the writeback result and the resulting note path metadata.
capabilities.human_handling: Preserve the source content and route vault conflicts for review.

capabilities.intent: Answer a supported real-time weather or market query.
capabilities.verify: Require a structured provider response with a recognized query class.
capabilities.human_handling: Report unavailable or unsupported real-time data without fabricating a result.

capabilities.intent: Process a direct web upload task and create its requested delivery artifacts.
capabilities.verify: Require a successful task response and the declared web artifact metadata.
capabilities.human_handling: Return validation failures to the web operator instead of publishing incomplete artifacts.

capabilities.intent: Check the active model profile and required local inference endpoints.
capabilities.verify: Require the model gate report to satisfy the expected profile and endpoint checks.
capabilities.human_handling: Keep a failed model gate visible for operator recovery rather than changing profiles automatically.

capabilities.intent: Run the MAGI acceptance boundary across configured checks.
capabilities.verify: Require a green acceptance status with no blocking failed gates.
capabilities.human_handling: Leave failed gates actionable for operator triage and do not infer readiness.

capabilities.intent: Create a managed database backup with integrity metadata.
capabilities.verify: Require successful backup metadata with a checksum and output path.
capabilities.human_handling: Keep failed backups visible for operator storage or database recovery.

capabilities.intent: Restore a verified database backup only after explicit confirmation and a pre-restore backup.
capabilities.verify: Require backup integrity verification, a successful pre-restore backup, and a successful restore result.
capabilities.rollback: Restore the pre-restore backup through the same confirmed recovery procedure.

capabilities.intent: Deliver a guarded operational notification and retain a retryable outbox entry on failure.
capabilities.verify: Inspect delivered, acknowledged, queued, and error status fields.
capabilities.human_handling: Use the outbox retry path when delivery is not acknowledged.
